# Lighthouse Maintenance Notes

The keeper inspects the lamp mechanism every morning before sunrise. A clean lens doubles the visible range of the beam on clear nights.

## Fuel

Kerosene lamps were replaced by electric bulbs in most stations after 1920. The backup generator is tested once a week under full load.
